decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to utilize aggressive artifact creatures and spells to quickly and efficiently deal damage to the opponent. The deck focuses on using cards like Ensoul Artifact, Spyglass Siren, and Voldaren Epicure to pump up artifact creatures and make them threatening. Cards like Smuggler's Copter and Reckless Bushwhacker provide additional aggression and value. By combining artifact synergy with aggressive creatures and burn spells like Shrapnel Blast and Torch the Tower, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents and win the game quickly.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with cards to enable the reanimation of Arclight Phoenix. By utilizing cards like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe for removal, as well as spells like Opt and Sleight of Hand for card selection, the deck aims to efficiently bring back Arclight Phoenix multiple times throughout the game to pressure the opponent and win through aggressive plays. The inclusion of Treasure Cruise also helps to refill the hand and maintain resources for continued aggression.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill your graveyard with instants and sorceries using cards like Opt, Sleight of Hand, and Treasure Cruise in order to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard for repeated attacks. Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse provide early removal while Ledger Shredder helps to further fuel your graveyard. The deck also includes counter spells like Spell Pierce for protection and has a land base that supports a fast mana curve. Picklock Prankster can provide additional card advantage while Otawara, Soaring City offers an alternate win condition.

This deck revolves around playing aggressively with Arclight Phoenix as the main win condition. Utilizing cheap spells like Lightning Axe, Opt, and Fiery Impulse to control the board and trigger the Phoenix's ability to return from the graveyard. Drawing cards with Treasure Cruise and Consider to dig for more Phoenixes and burn spells. Hall of Storm Giants provides a powerful late-game threat, while Picklock Prankster helps to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently with a mix of burn spells and flying creatures.

The deck focuses on utilizing Lotus Field's mana generating ability to power out powerful spells such as Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience quickly. It uses cards like Sylvan Scrying and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to search for Lotus Field and untap it for additional mana. Hidden Strings and Pore Over the Pages provide card advantage and manipulation, while Strict Proctor disrupts opponent's plays. The deck aims to set up a powerful combo turn where it can cast multiple spells in one turn for a game-winning sequence. It also includes utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Otawara, Soaring City for additional protection and value.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by using a variety of removal spells and board wipes to deal with threats from the opponent. The main win condition is Niv-Mizzet Reborn, who can provide card advantage and value by drawing multiple cards when it enters the battlefield. The deck also includes other powerful cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Omnath, Locus of Creation to help stabilize the board and generate additional advantage. By efficiently removing threats and drawing cards, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent in a grindy game.

This Rakdos Aggro deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its aggressive creatures and disruption spells. The deck focuses on playing efficient threats like Bonecrusher Giant, Reckoner Bankbuster, and Graveyard Trespasser to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total. Thoughtseize and Fatal Push help to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide additional threats and value. With a mix of early aggression and disruption, this deck aims to close out games swiftly and decisively.

This deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice effects and efficient removal spells to control the board while dealing consistent damage to the opponent. Cards like Cauldron Familiar and Mayhem Devil synergize well with cards like Witch's Oven and Deadly Dispute, creating a loop of sacrificing creatures for value. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds an additional threat to the deck while maintaining a strong mana base. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells.

This deck revolves around the combo potential of Amalia Benavides Aguirre. The goal is to gain incremental life through cards like Wildgrowth Walker and Prosperous Innkeeper while also generating mana with Gilded Goose. Chord of Calling and Collected Company help search for key combo pieces like Skyclave Apparition and Return to the Ranks. The deck also includes a few utility cards like Voice of Resurgence and Selfless Savior for protection and resilience. The inclusion of Aetherflux Reservoir suggests a potential win condition through life gain.

The main focus of this Pioneer 1 vs 1 deck is to quickly bring out Arclight Phoenixes through spells like Consider, Fiery Impulse, and Lightning Axe while utilizing cards like Pieces of the Puzzle, Treasure Cruise, and Galvanic Iteration to draw and cast spells efficiently. The inclusion of Hall of Storm Giants and Temporal Trespass adds extra power and versatility to the deck. Opt, Sleight of Hand, and Ledger Shredder help to filter through the deck, ensuring consistency in getting Arclight Phoenix into play. The mana base is optimized for a smooth curve and quick access to the required colors.

The deck focuses on aggressive play with a mix of creatures, removal spells, and disruption. It aims to put pressure on the opponent early with efficient threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Graveyard Trespasser, while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Duress and Thoughtseize. The mana base allows for flexibility in casting spells while maximizing efficiency. Overall, the deck seeks to control the board while delivering consistent damage to the opponent, ultimately leading to a quick victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing combo interactions and creating value through discovering synergies. It includes cards like Beanstalk Giant, Quintorius Kand, Leyline Binding, and Spark Double to generate powerful combos on the battlefield. The inclusion of Keruga, the Macrosage as a companion adds an additional layer of strategy. By leveraging cards like Bedeck / Bedazzle, Herd Migration, and Release to the Wind, the deck aims to control the board while setting up game-winning combos with Trumpeting Carnosaur and Greater Tanuki. With careful planning and resource management, the deck can overwhelm opponents with its versatile combo potential.

This deck utilizes the Amalia Life combo strategy in Pioneer 1 vs 1 format. The key concept revolves around using Amalia Benavides Aguirre as the centerpiece of the deck, supported by cards like Chord of Calling and Collected Company. It aims to summon powerful creatures like Dina, Soul Steeper and Knight-Errant of Eos to control the board and enhance its life-gain capabilities. The deck also includes various lands and support cards to facilitate the combo strategy, allowing players to maintain board presence and gain advantage through life-gain effects.

This deck focuses on utilizing control elements to slow down the opponent's game plan while setting up card advantage and win conditions through cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Shark Typhoon. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional card advantage and flexibility in longer games. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy, control the board, and out-value the opponent through efficient removal and card draw, ultimately winning through powerful threats and incremental advantage.

This UW Control deck focuses on using cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, Dovin's Veto, and Supreme Verdict to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The addition of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value by blinking permanents like Omen of the Sea and Shark Typhoon. The deck also includes cards like Change the Equation and Temporary Lockdown to further hinder the opponent's plans. With a combination of counterspells, board wipes, and card advantage, this deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

The deck aims to assemble a combo using Amalia Benavides Aguirre and various support creatures like Gilded Goose and Wildgrowth Walker, generating life gain triggers and creating a board presence. It utilizes cards like Collected Company and Chord of Calling to quickly find the key pieces needed for the combo. The inclusion of Aetherflux Reservoir serves as a win condition by dealing damage equal to the player's life total. The deck is designed to quickly combo off and overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of life gain triggers and powerful creatures.
